entries.123dc67927474a8e: A business for the nicotine- and tar-free electronic cigarette “SPADE” and similar products. Efforts to acquire new customers and various measures have ended, and the main revenue now comes from delivery of regular shipments to existing subscription customers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥46 million.
entries.2c3347c1a8f23e97: A single-segment business that sells health and beauty products and beauty appliances under its own original brands, and purchases and sells medical devices such as colored contact lenses. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥11,210 million. The company operates from offices at its Sapporo and Tokyo headquarters.
entries.b8788218c0b59be0: A mail-order company that sells its own original-brand health and beauty products, beauty appliances and other items to general consumers, mainly through EC.
entries.cacd576c2ca9cde3: General consumers (mainly in their 40s and older)
entries.d487568bda922dd2: General consumers who purchase through its own EC site and EC malls
entries.f0bc5f25f04e3030: A business in which consolidated subsidiary Karakon Dairekuto Co., Ltd. purchases and sells medical devices such as colored contact lenses. It sells through EC malls such as Qoo10 and Rakuten Ichiba. Because it became a consolidated subsidiary in December 2025, revenue of ¥236 million for the fiscal year ended February 2026 covers the fourth quarter only.
entries.f1b269b630c31992: A business operated by consolidated subsidiary SALONMOON Co., Ltd., which plans and develops beauty appliances such as hair irons and hair dryers under its original hair care brand, with manufacturing outsourced to OEM partners. It sells mainly through EC malls such as Amazon, Rakuten Ichiba and Qoo10, and also sells in stores at some electronics retailers and discount stores. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥898 million.
